### The Comfort of God’s Ways
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-april-28-2023.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:3-4
Points:
- Experiencing God's comfort in affliction equips believers to comfort others facing trials.
- Extending genuine compassion requires overcoming personal bitterness and self-absorption.
- Philosophical answers often wound, whereas quiet, empathetic presence brings true relief.
- The greatest consolation believers can offer is pointing sufferers directly to Christ.

### We Can Pass God's Comfort Along
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/we-can-pass-gods-comfort-along.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:3-4
Points:
- Being honest about personal struggles creates opportunities to minister to other hurting people.
- God never stands distant; He enters directly into human pain with His love and presence.
- Divine comfort is comprehensive and able to reach into every kind of trouble.
- God comforts believers with the clear intention that they channel His comfort to others.
